answer: Each identity's trust score decays exponentially every epoch and refreshes only via signed, paid interactions with counterparties from distinct graph neighborhoods. A cloned wallet is a relic instantly: clones share funding, timing and counterpart history, so refresh traffic clusters in one neighborhood while each ripple of coordinated activity flags the cluster and speeds decay. Honest agents accrue weight like nectar from many real partners. Attacker cost is linear: every clone needs fresh genuine counterparties each epoch, so scaling the farm multiplies overhead with no compounding.
